title: Classes and Objects
description: Defining your own types: classes, objects and constructors, access modifiers and encapsulation, then what a reference really is: stack versus heap, string immutability, == versus equals, final and toString, and enums.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Foundation days F4-F18 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3 to /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2). This module covers F9, F11 (/tracks/0/weeks/1/days/3, /tracks/0/weeks/2/days/0).
Module grouping is a second-mate grouping decision recorded at intake (matrix record source-gap-java-foundations-modules), not syllabus: modules follow calendar day order and hold 4-9 topics.
Every calendar row of these days maps to exactly one topic with relation exact; there are no splits or shared rows.
